actual_capital_interpretation: The latest explicit issuer statement located for the Cantor facility says Evernorth had received zero proceeds under that facility as of the October 30, 2026 S-1 prospectus date.
The $80.7 million figure is illustrative capacity at a reference share price, not cash raised. Facility purchases require Evernorth notices and multiple conditions.
The $521,893.50 upfront commitment fee is a fee payable to Cantor, not capital raised. The reviewed filings do not establish that it had actually been remitted by the research cutoff.
The $132,249,908 public-warrant amount is a maximum arithmetic cash-exercise scenario, not realized proceeds. The company receives no proceeds from secondary sales of the registered shares.

The $214.05 million advance-funding cash is historical actual cash received, and the S-1 reports approximately $214 million was used to acquire XRP. It must not be counted again as current available cash.
The $10.5 million delayed-funding cash consideration, in-kind XRP contributions and $30 million PIK note are separate categories. They must not be combined into a single 'XRP purchases' figure.
In-kind XRP contributions increase treasury holdings but are not contemporaneous open-market purchases. PIK notes are debt financing, not equity.

source_disagreement_and_gaps.secondary_reporting: Some secondary reports described the ELOC registration as effective on October 30. The reviewed issuer S-1 is dated October 30 and explicitly reports zero facility proceeds as of its prospectus date; this artifact does not infer commencement or fee payment from secondary reporting.
source_disagreement_and_gaps.current_status_after_2026_10_30: No later primary filing confirming Cantor facility drawdown was located in this run. Absence of a later filing is not proof that no draw occurred after October 30.
source_disagreement_and_gaps.warrant_exercises: No exercise count or proceeds receipt was established in the reviewed filings.
source_disagreement_and_gaps.current_cash: Historical subscription cash, debt proceeds and XRP purchases do not establish Evernorth's current unrestricted cash balance.

exact_phrase_resolution.conclusion: Use actual cash received, in-kind XRP, debt proceeds, contingent facility capacity, warrant-exercise potential and fees as separate typed fields. Do not label announced capacity or warrant arithmetic as actual capital.

model_admission.reason: Capital-structure research is not an XRP market feature until time-stamped, independently receipted and linked to verified XRP purchases/flows.
